lead.title: OpenAI says upcoming Astra model solved ten open problems in mathematics
lead.summary: OpenAI reports an internal version of its upcoming Astra model solved ten open problems in mathematics and theoretical computer science, spanning geometry, cryptography and complexity, for roughly $2,000 in compute. The results come with a paper, LLM-generated proof reconstructions and Lean 4 formalizations.

top_stories.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 lands on the price/performance frontier
top_stories.summary: Simon Willison tests the cost-efficient LLM, which lands on the Artificial Analysis Pareto frontier at a fraction of comparable costs (~0.44 cents default inference) with a 98% cache-hit discount seen as transformative for agent loops.

top_stories.title: Over 1,000 AI lab employees sign 'Pacing the Frontier' urging the US to slow automated AI
top_stories.summary: More than 1,000 employees from OpenAI, Anthropic and other labs signed the statement asking the US government to build tools deliberately designed to slow down automated AI development.

top_stories.title: BYD to debut its first humanoid robots in early August at Di Space venues
top_stories.summary: The automaker will unveil its first humanoid robots at its Di Space experience venues, positioning BYD against Tesla in the embodied AI race.

items.title: Repeated sampling beats self-refine and reflexion at equal token cost
items.summary: A controlled study from 1.5B to 7B models shows reflection methods that generate extra text are beaten by simple repeated sampling at equal token budgets, isolating the accuracy gain of reflection to generating more tokens.

items.title: Echoverse generates deep, evolving environments to train computer-use agents
items.summary: The pipeline generates reset-able synthetic environments for computer-use agent training, targeting stateful login-gated applications and scaling beyond prior bulk pipelines.

items.title: Memory Decoder at Scale: a pretrained, parametric long-term memory for LMs
items.summary: Scales a parametric long-term memory module to much larger capacities, decoupling memory from reasoning parameters for independently scalable long-term memory.

items.title: WIDE boosts adaptive LLM inference via token-level dynamic width pruning
items.summary: Token-level dynamic width pruning allocates compute per token to reduce accuracy loss under aggressive sparsity versus static structured pruning.

items.title: ReToken adds a retrieval token to improve vision-language models on visual retrieval
items.summary: A single learnable embedding as an explicit retrieval token lets VLMs handle long visual context with many distractors while staying within GPU memory.

items.title: CleanSlate — open-source coding agent for IDE, CLI and SDK
items.summary: An open-source AI coding agent that works across the IDE, command line and SDK, positioning itself as a cleaner alternative to Claude Code left-behinds.

items.title: Cockpit for Claude Code agents — a Rust-based control panel
items.summary: A Rust-built cockpit dashboard giving users visibility and control over their Claude Code agents in one place.

items.title: Pronto — a real-time wire for AI agents with 70k+ feeds connected
items.summary: A real-time data feed/wire service for AI agents, claiming 70,000+ connected sources for live agent inputs.

items.title: CostPerPrompt — live AI API pricing and real-workload cost calculators
items.summary: Tracks live per-prompt pricing across AI APIs and offers real-workload cost calculators to compare model expenses.

items.title: Evidence-to-Skill — a gate between untrusted sources and agent skills
items.summary: A gate mechanism that filters untrusted external sources before they can influence or become agent skills, adding a safety layer to agent tooling.

items.title: Bending Spoons one month after IPO: shares down 13%, new M&A in sight
items.summary: The Milan-based software house has lost over 13% from its $40 peak since its July 1 Nasdaq debut, and announced €500M in new medium-long term financing from HSBC, Intesa Sanpaolo and BPER backed by SACE, bringing funding lines to €1.49B as it pursues further acquisitions.

items.title: Metriks AI subscribes first tranche of capital increase in BeBeez publisher EdiBeez
items.summary: The B2B AI company listed on Euronext Growth Milan paid the first €75,000 tranche of a €150,000 capital increase in EdiBeez, taking a roughly 3.5% minority stake.
